recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a separate policy statement about packages.fhir.org or CI-build behavior for packages containing local-path dependencies.
issue_request: FHIR-25772 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking FHIR package.json dependencies to support npm-style local path dependencies such as file:/local/path. The resolution approved support for absolute or relative local paths and an NPM Package specification update, while noting the HL7 package stack and server would not support this.
initial_application: Commit 843626fb5df45ceca0f4f66bdef13eca69f8f042 (FHIR-25772: Local Package dependencies) updated source/packages.html in the package.json dependencies row to say that development packages may use a local path for the package version and linked to npm Local Paths documentation.
additional_context: source/packages.html is part of the current build page hierarchy via source/hierarchy.xml and is linked from source/documentation.html. FHIR-I WGM minutes and the contemporaneous Zulip tooling thread confirm the approved scope: allow local-path dependencies for development/private use without requiring support from public HL7 package infrastructure such as packages.fhir.org or CI-build.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already conveys the package-spec behavior requested by the Jira and links to npm local-path syntax that covers file: relative and absolute paths. Adding package-server caveats would be operational guidance beyond the source correction required for this issue.
